title: Nex-N1: Agentic Models Trained via a Unified Ecosystem for Large-Scale Environment Construction

why: Agent data is fragmented by environment and schema, making it hard to train one model across coding, research, browsing, and tool calling.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Agent data is fragmented by environment and schema, making it hard to train one model across coding, research, browsing, and tool calling.

Nex Agent-SFT reselects tasks from the Nex ecosystem, regenerates responses with a tool-capable teacher, and publishes six splits under one message-and-tools contract. The decision boundary is whether a serialized record survives environment-grounded trajectory generation, split-specific validity checks, and downstream agent evaluation; the direct output is Nex Agent-SFT, consumed by agent SFT rather than an evaluation-only benchmark.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2512.04987; venue/date arXiv preprint (2025); open data Nex Agent-SFT at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nex-agi/agent-sft; scale 69,008 records across agentic code, agent, chat, deep research, HTML, and tool-calling splits; full paper, official README, terms, schema, and one actual record checked on 2026-07-27.

代理数据按环境和结构分散，单一模型难以同时学习代码、研究、浏览与工具调用。

该发布从 Nex 环境重新选择任务，用具备工具能力的教师重生成回答，并按六种能力切分公开。 判定边界是记录能否通过“环境落地的轨迹生成、按切分有效性检查和下游代理评测”并成为代理监督微调的输入；直接产物是 Nex Agent-SFT，不是只用于评测的基准。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2512.04987，日期与状态为 2025 年预印本；开放数据为 Nex Agent-SFT，规模是69008 条记录，分为代理代码、代理、对话、深度研究、网页和工具调用六类；已于 2026-07-27 核验全文、官方说明、条款、字段和一条实际公开记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Nex Agent-SFT reselects tasks from the Nex ecosystem, regenerates responses with a tool-capable teacher, and publishes six splits under one message-and-tools contract. Relative to separate single-domain agent instruction sets, it changes the reusable target to messages, tool definitions, uuid, and generator and makes environment-grounded trajectory generation, split-specific validity checks, and downstream agent evaluation the feedback boundary, so the central contribution is Track 01 data rather than a model-only, verifier-only, or benchmark-only artifact.

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: Nex Agent-SFT Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nex-agi/agent-sft Scale: 69,008 records across agentic code, agent, chat, deep research, HTML, and tool-calling splits Record form: messages, tool definitions, uuid, and generator File / storage format: Parquet records Domains / languages: English coding, research, chat, HTML generation, and tool-using agents Construction and filtering: DeepSeek-V3.1-Nex-N1 regenerates tool-aware multi-turn responses; environment-grounded trajectory generation, split-specific validity checks, and downstream agent evaluation License / access constraints: ODC-BY Intended use: agent SFT

该发布从 Nex 环境重新选择任务，用具备工具能力的教师重生成回答，并按六种能力切分公开。 相比彼此分离的单领域代理指令集，它把“消息、工具定义、记录编号和生成器”变成可复用目标，并以“环境落地的轨迹生成、按切分有效性检查和下游代理评测”作为反馈边界，因此中心贡献属于 Track 01 数据，而不是只发布模型、验证器或基准。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source and normalize the task. Input: queries selected from Nex-N1 environments and six capability splits. Operation: Normalize prompts, source identifiers, media or tools, references, and expected outputs into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject a candidate when its task input, source, access terms, or required reference is missing.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: A normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: DeepSeek-V3.1-Nex-N1 regenerates tool-aware multi-turn responses. Output and transition: The resulting answer, rationale, or tool trace is serialized as messages, tool definitions, uuid, and generator and advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to its prompt, authoring mechanism, or required environment state.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and task-specific correctness metadata. Operation: Apply environment-grounded trajectory generation, split-specific validity checks, and downstream agent evaluation. Output and transition: Passing records form 69,008 records across agentic code, agent, chat, deep research, HTML, and tool-calling splits stored as Parquet records and advance to training. Check / stop rule: Reject failed checks; final-answer agreement alone is not treated as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The pinned dataset revision and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for agent SFT and compare with separate single-domain agent instruction sets. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the paper's controlled evaluation become the final artifacts. Check / stop rule: Pin the data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, seeds, and harness, and do not generalize beyond evaluated domains.

步骤 1：取得并规范任务。输入是从 Nex-N1 环境与六种能力切分中重新选择的问题。操作是统一题目、来源、媒体或工具、参考信息与预期输出。输出是可审计候选，随后进入目标生成。检查与停止规则是缺少任务输入、来源、使用条款或必要参考时立即拒绝。

步骤 2：写入可复用目标。输入是规范候选及其来源证据。操作是由DeepSeek-V3.1-Nex-N1 重生成多轮工具回答。输出是按“消息、工具定义、记录编号和生成器”序列化的答案、推理或工具轨迹，随后进入验证。检查与停止规则是目标无法对应题目、生成机制或必要环境状态时停止。

步骤 3：验证并打包。输入是生成目标与任务专用正确性信息。操作是执行环境落地的轨迹生成、按切分有效性检查和下游代理评测。输出是通过检查的69008 条记录，分为代理代码、代理、对话、深度研究、网页和工具调用六类，按官方格式保存并进入训练。检查与停止规则是拒绝失败记录，且不把终答一致当作每个中间步骤都正确的证明。

步骤 4：训练并评估消费方。输入是固定版本的数据与论文基础检查点。操作是用于代理监督微调，并与彼此分离的单领域代理指令集比较。输出是训练后模型和受控评测。检查与停止规则是固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型、随机种子与评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Decisive downstream experiment: Nex-N1 consistently beats the open-source baselines reported on SWE-bench and tau2 and approaches proprietary systems; the paper evaluates the wider ecosystem, not Agent-SFT in isolation. This is evidence for the complete data intervention under the reported training setup, not proof that every released record is correct.

Artifact check: the official release contains 69,008 records across agentic code, agent, chat, deep research, HTML, and tool-calling splits and exposes actual fields messages, tool definitions, uuid, and generator; on 2026-07-27 its page reported 1281 downloads. Usage is only an impact cross-check, not a causal experiment.

决定性下游实验：Nex-N1 在论文报告的 SWE-bench 与 tau2 上持续超过开放基线，并接近专有系统；评测对象是完整生态，不能把收益单独归给 Agent-SFT。 这只能支持论文报告训练设置下的完整数据干预，不能证明每条公开记录都正确。

产物核验：官方发布包含69008 条记录，分为代理代码、代理、对话、深度研究、网页和工具调用六类，实际字段是“消息、工具定义、记录编号和生成器”；2026-07-27 数据页显示 1281 次下载。使用量只作影响交叉检查，不是因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest baseline is separate single-domain agent instruction sets. The paper changes the reusable object by making messages, tool definitions, uuid, and generator explicit and coupling it to environment-grounded trajectory generation, split-specific validity checks, and downstream agent evaluation. That is a direction signal because another team can train agent SFT from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是彼此分离的单领域代理指令集。真正变化是把“消息、工具定义、记录编号和生成器”显式化，并与“环境落地的轨迹生成、按切分有效性检查和下游代理评测”绑定。另一团队可直接用公开记录训练代理监督微调，因此它构成数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. When regenerated traces can imitate teacher shortcuts instead of environment-grounded recovery, the most serious consequence is training on a trace whose apparent correctness does not match its reasoning; reproduce a stratified record-level audit before reuse.
  2. Because the paper does not isolate the contribution of each of six splits, downstream gains may not transfer to a new domain or deployment; run source- and domain-specific evaluations rather than relying on the aggregate score.
  3. Reuse must preserve ODC-BY and every upstream source or media term; exclude records whose provenance or redistribution right cannot be reconstructed.

1. 如果重生成轨迹可能模仿教师捷径，而非学习环境中的错误恢复，最严重后果是把表面正确但推理不实的轨迹用于训练；复用前应按来源和难度分层抽样复核。
  2. 由于论文没有隔离六个切分各自的贡献，汇总收益未必迁移到新领域或部署环境；应分别运行来源级和领域级评测。
  3. 复用必须遵守 ODC-BY 及全部上游来源或媒体条款；无法重建来源和再分发权利的记录应排除。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For teams building agent SFT, pin the official revision, preserve source fields, train a fixed-backbone baseline, and output both a versioned mixture and domain-level metrics. The intervention succeeds only if the target gains survive a provenance and error audit.
  • For auditors, sample records by source and difficulty and replay environment-grounded trajectory generation, split-specific validity checks, and downstream agent evaluation. Produce a keep/reject ledger with failure reasons; do not use the dataset when licenses, task inputs, or verification artifacts are unavailable.

• 构建代理监督微调的团队应固定官方版本、保留来源字段、训练同骨干基线，并输出带版本的数据混合与分领域指标。只有目标收益通过来源和错误审计后，才算复用成功。
  • 数据审计者应按来源和难度抽样，重放环境落地的轨迹生成、按切分有效性检查和下游代理评测，输出带失败原因的保留与拒绝台账。许可、任务输入或验证产物缺失时不应使用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: Nex Agent-SFT reselects tasks from the Nex ecosystem, regenerates responses with a tool-capable teacher, and publishes six splits under one message-and-tools contract.
  • Data object: 69,008 records across agentic code, agent, chat, deep research, HTML, and tool-calling splits; each record exposes messages, tool definitions, uuid, and generator.
  • Author and selector: DeepSeek-V3.1-Nex-N1 regenerates tool-aware multi-turn responses; retention uses environment-grounded trajectory generation, split-specific validity checks, and downstream agent evaluation.
  • Evidence anchor: Nex-N1 consistently beats the open-source baselines reported on SWE-bench and tau2 and approaches proprietary systems; the paper evaluates the wider ecosystem, not Agent-SFT in isolation.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for agent SFT; first audit regenerated traces can imitate teacher shortcuts instead of environment-grounded recovery and the paper does not isolate the contribution of each of six splits.

• 定位：Nex Agent-SFT 把 69008 条代码、研究、对话、网页和工具轨迹统一为消息与工具结构。
  • 数据对象：69008 条记录，分为代理代码、代理、对话、深度研究、网页和工具调用六类，单条记录包含消息、工具定义、记录编号和生成器。
  • 生成与筛选：DeepSeek-V3.1-Nex-N1 重生成多轮工具回答，并依据环境落地的轨迹生成、按切分有效性检查和下游代理评测保留。
  • 证据锚点：Nex-N1 在论文报告的 SWE-bench 与 tau2 上持续超过开放基线，并接近专有系统；评测对象是完整生态，不能把收益单独归给 Agent-SFT。
  • 复用决定：适合代理监督微调；先审计重生成轨迹可能模仿教师捷径，而非学习环境中的错误恢复和论文没有隔离六个切分各自的贡献。
